title: Network search
intro: Other agencies' shared listings and new-builds, with the commission you earn.

view.mapFailed: The map could not be loaded.

gate.lockedTitle: Share listings to search the network
gate.lockedBody: Network search is for agencies that share: {shared} of {threshold} active listings shared with the network so far.
gate.grace: You are in your welcome period until {date}. Share {threshold} active listings with the network to keep searching it.
gate.exempt: Your agency searches the network without sharing (buyer-only agency).

results.count: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# result} other {About # results}}
results.none: Nothing on the network matches these filters.

commission.earnUnknown: Your share: ask the listing agent

errors.FORBIDDEN: Network search is not available in Client Mode or for your role.
errors.VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: Network search opens once your agency is verified.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Network search is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.

collaborations.title: My collaborations
collaborations.intro: Client registrations and viewing requests with other agencies, in both directions, and where they stand.
collaborations.load: The collaborations could not be loaded. Try again.

register.title: Register a client
register.explain: The first valid registration of a client for this target wins. The owner sees your agency and the dates, never the client.
register.own: This belongs to your agency, so there is nobody to register a client with.
register.noTerms: You can register the client, but a viewing cannot be requested until the owner publishes commission terms.
register.find: Find a contact by e-mail or phone
register.findNone: No contact has this e-mail or phone.
register.findInvalid: Enter a full e-mail address or phone number.
register.noRecent: You have no contacts with an e-mail or phone yet. Find one above or create one.
register.recentFailed: Your contacts could not be loaded. Find one by e-mail or phone, or reload the page.

request.note: Requesting accepts the target’s current commission terms for your agency.
request.open: A viewing is already open for this client.

actions.acceptNote: Accepting also accepts the commission terms for your agency. They cannot change afterwards.
actions.declineConfirm: Decline this viewing? This closes the request.
actions.rescheduleNote: Proposing a time also accepts the commission terms for your agency.
actions.cancelConfirm: Cancel this viewing? This closes it for both agencies.

hints.BIND_LISTING: Only your agency’s admins or the listing’s agent can accept or propose a time, because that binds the agency to the commission.
hints.BIND_DEVELOPMENT: Only your agency’s admins can accept or propose a time for a development, because that binds the agency to the commission.
hints.OUTCOME_LATER: The outcome can be recorded after the scheduled time.
hints.LAPSED: This proposal was not answered in time and is about to close.

blocked.CLIENT_MODE: Collaborations are not available in Client Mode.
blocked.IMPERSONATING: Support staff acting as a member cannot register clients or answer viewings, because that binds the agency.
blocked.ROLE: Your role cannot register clients or answer viewings.
blocked.UNVERIFIED: Only verified agencies can register clients and answer viewings on the network.
blocked.LOCKED: Your agency has to share more listings on the network before it can register clients or request viewings. You can still answer what is already open.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You cannot do this: it takes a member of a verified agency with the right role.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Your agency has to wait before trying again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the fields and try again.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This form was already sent with other values. Open the page again and retry.
errors.NO_EMAIL_OR_PHONE: This contact has no e-mail or phone, which a registration needs. Add one to the contact first.
errors.CONTACT_NOT_FOUND: That contact no longer exists in your agency.
errors.REGISTRATION_CONFLICT: Another agency already has a valid registration of this client for this target, so yours was not recorded.
errors.REGISTRATION_TARGET_NOT_FOUND: This listing or development is not available on the network any more, or belongs to your agency.
errors.REGISTRATION_NOT_FOUND: This registration is not valid any more. Register the client again.
errors.PAST: Choose a time in the future.
errors.AFTER_REGISTRATION: Choose a time before the registration ends.
errors.VIEWING_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND: This viewing request does not exist any more.
errors.VIEWING_REQUEST_OPEN: This client already has an open viewing for this target. Answer or cancel that one first.
errors.VIEWING_TERMS_INCOMPLETE: The owner has not published a commission and split for this target, so a viewing cannot be requested yet. Ask the owner to complete them.
errors.STATE_EXPIRED: This proposal expired before it was answered.
errors.STATE_NOT_AWAITING: The other agency has to answer this proposal, not yours.
errors.STATE_TOO_LATE: The scheduled time has passed, so it cannot be moved. Record the outcome instead.
errors.STATE_NOT_SCHEDULED: The outcome can only be recorded for a scheduled viewing.
errors.STATE_TOO_EARLY: The outcome can be recorded after the scheduled time.
errors.STATE_CHANGED: This viewing has just changed. Check where it stands and try again.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again.
errors.NETWORK_GIVE_TO_GET_LOCKED: Your agency has to share more listings before it can start new collaborations. It can still answer the ones already open.
errors.DEAL_VIEWING_NOT_ELIGIBLE: This viewing cannot carry a deal: the terms must be accepted and the viewing scheduled or attended.

done.registered: Client registered. You can now request a viewing below.
done.alreadyRegistered: Your agency had already registered this client for this target, and that registration is still valid. Nothing new was recorded.
done.viewingRequested: Viewing requested. The owner has been told.
done.rescheduled: New time proposed. The other agency has to answer it.

terms.title: Viewing terms
terms.pdfPending: The PDF is being prepared. Reload this page shortly.
terms.pdfAfterAccept: The PDF is available once the owner accepts the terms.

deal.note: The deal carries the commission terms both agencies accepted. If the viewing has a deal already, you go to it.

board.title: Network board
board.intro: Buyer requests, property offers, distressed sales and developer announcements from agencies on the network. Reply to start a chat with the poster; subscribe to be told about matching posts.

post.title: Post to the network
post.bodyHelp: No phone numbers or e-mail addresses: contact happens in the chat.

subscriptions.title: My subscriptions
subscriptions.intro: You get a notification when a new post matches a subscription.
subscriptions.name: Name

done.posted: Your post is on the board.

errors.load: The board could not be loaded. Try again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the fields. Titles and texts must not contain phone numbers or e-mail addresses.
errors.VALIDATION_EXPIRY: Choose a number of days between 1 and the maximum allowed for how long the post stays up.
errors.VALIDATION_PRICE: Check the prices: use whole numbers, and the minimum cannot be higher than the maximum.
errors.VALIDATION_CONTACT: Titles and texts must not contain phone numbers or e-mail addresses. Replies go through chat.
errors.VALIDATION_TEXT: The title and the text are required and have a length limit.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You cannot do this on the board.
errors.VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: Posting and replying open once your agency is verified.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.NETWORK_POST_NOT_FOUND: That post is no longer there.
errors.NETWORK_SUBSCRIPTION_LIMIT: You have reached the number of subscriptions allowed.

savedSearches.title: Saved searches
savedSearches.intro: Save a search and get an alert when a listing that matches it comes on the market, drops its price or is back on the market — in your notifications and your e-mail summary.
savedSearches.empty: You have no saved searches yet.
savedSearches.beds: {count, plural, one {# bedroom or more} other {# bedrooms or more}}

errors.load: Your saved searches could not be loaded. Try again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the search: a value was not valid.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.SAVED_SEARCH_NOT_FOUND: That saved search no longer exists.
errors.SAVED_SEARCH_LIMIT: You can keep at most {max} saved searches. Delete one first.
errors.NETWORK_GIVE_TO_GET_LOCKED: Your agency shares too few listings with the network to watch it. Choose “Our listings only”, or share more listings first.
errors.VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: Only verified agencies can watch the network. Choose “Our listings only” until your agency is verified.

deals.title: Deals
deals.intro: Sales with other agencies, from an accepted viewing to the completion: the stage, the price, the commission from the agreed terms, documents, tasks and the chat.
deals.emptyHint: Open a deal from an accepted viewing in My collaborations.
deals.actingReadOnly: You are acting as this member: the deal is shown read-only.
deals.bindHint: Only your agency’s admins or the listing’s agent can move this deal on your side.

price.label: Agreed price
price.note: Changing the price clears both sides’ completion confirmations.

advance.label: Move forward:
advance.confirm: Move the deal to {stage}? A deal never moves back.

fallThrough.note: A fallen-through deal is closed for both agencies; only Inmolink can reopen it.
fallThrough.confirm: Close this deal as fallen through? This cannot be undone by either agency.

handshake.intro: The deal completes when both agencies confirm the completion at the same price.
handshake.confirmAsk: Confirm the completion at {price}? Once both agencies confirm, the deal is closed.

documents.intro: PDFs both agencies read: the offer, the contracts, the deed, invoices. Only the uploading agency removes one, while the deal is open.
documents.removeAsk: Remove “{name}”? It stays listed as removed for both agencies.

tasks.intro: Your agency’s own tasks about this deal. The other agency never sees them.
tasks.title: New task

chat.intro: One thread between the two agencies’ people on this deal. Nothing about the client is shared.

disputes.intro: If the two agencies cannot agree — on the price, a stage, the completion or the commission — ask Inmolink to mediate. The other agency is told a dispute was raised, not what you wrote.
disputes.hint: To send evidence (a contract, an e-mail), open a support ticket and attach it.
disputes.confirm: Send this dispute to Inmolink for mediation?

done.priced: Price saved. Both confirmations were cleared.
done.fellThrough: The deal is closed as fallen through.
done.disputed: Dispute sent. Inmolink will get back to you here.

errors.DEAL_NOT_FOUND: This deal does not exist or is not your agency’s.
errors.DEAL_DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND: This document is not available any more.
errors.DEAL_DISPUTE_STATE: Your agency already has an open dispute on this deal.
errors.DEAL_STATE: The deal cannot take this now.

errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This form was sent already. Reload the page.
errors.DOCUMENT_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: Only PDF files can be uploaded.
errors.DOCUMENT_LIMIT_REACHED: This deal has the most documents it can hold.
errors.CHAT_THREAD_NOT_FOUND: The chat is not available for this deal.

states.closed: The deal is closed: only Inmolink can change it now. Raise a dispute if something is wrong.
states.price_changed: The price changed meanwhile. Check the new price and confirm again.
states.changed: The deal changed meanwhile. Check it and try again.
states.live_deal: This viewing has another live deal.
